semantics: For each session row type (a durable arm of packages/harness/src/shared/schemas/sessionEvent.ts), the production files that read it, by comparing, switching on or listing the type literal, outside its reducers and the row vocabulary (REDUCERS and VOCABULARY in src/test-kernel/architecture/factOwnerRatchet.vitest.ts). Each such file decides the row's fact on its own. Shrink-only: a file not listed fails (read the state the reducer builds instead); a listed file that stopped reading fails until the list is rewritten with `npx vitest run src/test-kernel/architecture/factOwnerRatchet.vitest.ts -u`, which only drops entries. A type absent from the list has no reader outside its reducers.
